name: Green Square Mountain View
camera_perspective: Fixed side-view camera showing the full play area with the mountain background
art_style: Minimalist flat design with a single green square sprite over a photographic-style mountain landscape background
mechanics: Player movement via arrow keys or WASD
Static mountain background displayed behind player
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move the green square horizontally and vertically
level_structure: A single open 2D area with no obstacles or goals; the player can move freely within the screen bounds while the mountain background remains static.

required_assets.prompt: A solid green square primitive, flat color, no texture, no border, 64x64 pixels
A scenic mountain landscape background image, with layered mountain silhouettes, sky, and natural colors, suitable for a 2D game environment

requirements.original_instruction: a very simple game that has a green square primitive as a player
requirements.implementation: Create a player object represented by a green square sprite. The player can move in 2D space using arrow keys or WASD. The player is constrained to the visible screen area.

requirements.original_instruction: an image background with montagnes as a environement background
requirements.implementation: Create a background image asset depicting mountains and display it as the environment background in the main scene, behind the player.

tasks.description: Set up Unity project with a 2D scene, camera, and basic input handling for player movement.
Create the green square sprite asset (procedurally generated as a simple colored quad) and implement player movement with screen bounds.
Generate the mountain background image using an image generation tool and import it into the project.
Place the mountain background image in the scene as a full-screen background layer behind the player.
Verify that the player moves correctly and the background displays properly in a playtest.

assumptions: The game is a simple 2D scene with no goals, scoring, or win/lose conditions.
The player can move in all four directions using arrow keys or WASD.
The mountain background is a static image displayed behind the player.
No audio, UI, or additional gameplay mechanics are required.
limitations: The green square sprite is a primitive and cannot be generated as an image; it is created procedurally in code.
The mountain background is generated as an image and may not perfectly match a specific artistic style.
No 3D models or animations are included.
